title: SEC-R2: /log-tip queries wrong pool and nonexistent table
description: In transit/src/admin.rs, build_log_tip_json (line 410) queries 'SELECT MAX(sequence_number), cid FROM group_log WHERE group_name = ?' but: (1) this table does not exist in either migration set — the core schema uses log_entries/group_tips, transit schema has articles/peers/peer_groups; (2) the dispatch at line 264 passes transit_pool rather than core_pool. The module doc comment at line 82 says core_pool holds 'msgid_map, group_log'. The /log-tip endpoint silently returns 404 for all groups at runtime. This is a pre-existing functional bug (not introduced by the c3z.8 fix), but it means the /log-tip admin endpoint has never worked and the table/column schema does not match any migration.
